description: Along the public colony road in Frederiksoord, small houses show a brick living front and a lower wooden barn at the rear, set behind straight plots. The museum and the ticketed cottage are closed, so this is the street of houses that remain in the landscape. It is overcast, about 7.4°C, with wind near 1.8 km/h and cloud cover about 83%. Late September leaves are still on the trees. No snow is shown.
